title: Mogitate SegaSaturn Vol. 2
native_title: モギタテセガサターン Ｖｏｌ．２ １９９８．２
overview: The second issue of Mogitate Sega Saturn, the members-only information disc sent to Sega Partners, Sega's Saturn fan club. The issue mixes playable demos of Saturn games with interviews and video features. A separate special edition disc of Sakura Taisen 2 came in the same package.
